$doc: agent-hill-climb ratchet manifest. limits are seeded from CURRENT measured values at scaffold time — tighten later, never relax. 'max' rules fail when live count exceeds limit; 'min' rules fail when live count is under limit.

rules.name: todo-count
rules.hint: Seeded 0? No: seed from `rg -c 'TODO|FIXME'`. Replace this example line with the real measured count on init.

rules.name: lint-warnings
rules.hint: Example for Python; swap the command for the project's real linter (eslint for JS etc.). parse=last_integer takes the final integer in stdout.

rules.name: type-errors
rules.hint: For TS use "tsc --noEmit | tail -1". Seed the real count, then tighten.

rules.name: test-count
rules.hint: Min-rules never fail-below what exists (tests can't be silently deleted).
